project: VARDHANI HIGH-SPECIALIST R3 — GPT-5.6 SOL TEACHER / STUDENT-250 V2
purpose: Model opening dislocations as two causally distinguishable market behaviours instead of assuming every displacement should continue: an efficient cross-market continuation specialist and an explicit rejection/reversal specialist. Increase opportunity count through multiple behavioural specialists, not by relaxing the economic qualification gate.

predecessor_evidence.R3H: Very selective opening continuation Q0.70 showed strong but sparse 2023 economics.
predecessor_evidence.R3I: Extending continuation logic broadly into midday destroyed the signal.
predecessor_evidence.R3J: Dense opening continuation produced weak positive net3 but failed net5 and robustness.
predecessor_evidence.R3K: Waiting five minutes for generic persistence confirmation reduced count and produced negative economics.
predecessor_evidence.design_inference: Keep research localized to the opening regime, enter without generic delay, and explicitly distinguish efficient continuation from visible causal rejection rather than treating rejected moves as continuation candidates.
not_permitted: automatic inversion of losing historical trades

common_state.adaptive_history: previous 126 completed trading-date observations at the same clock checkpoint only
common_state.dislocation_condition: abs opening gap >= same-checkpoint historical Q0.60 AND abs NIFTY causal 30-minute return >= same-checkpoint historical Q0.60

continuation_specialist.name: CONT
conditions: NIFTY causal 5-minute return has same sign as 30-minute direction
NIFTY causal 15-minute return has same sign as 30-minute direction
SENSEX causal 15-minute return has same sign as direction
India VIX causal 15-minute return has opposite sign to direction
NIFTY causal trend_eff_15 >= previous-126 same-checkpoint median
CE direction requires NIFTY session_pos>=0.65; PE direction requires session_pos<=0.35
continuation_specialist.horizon_router: 120 minutes when trend_eff_30 >= previous-126 same-checkpoint median, otherwise 60 minutes

rejection_specialist.name: REJECT
rejection_specialist.direction: opposite sign of the NIFTY causal 30-minute dislocation
conditions: NIFTY causal 5-minute return has opposite sign to the 30-minute dislocation
current NIFTY candle body has opposite sign to the 30-minute dislocation
for an up-dislocation, upper_wick_frac >= previous-126 same-checkpoint Q0.60; for a down-dislocation, lower_wick_frac >= previous-126 same-checkpoint Q0.60
SENSEX causal 5-minute return is not confirming the dislocation: dislocation_sign*SENSEX_ret5 <= 0
India VIX causal 5-minute return conflicts with the dislocation: dislocation_sign*VIX_ret5 >= 0
rejection_specialist.horizon_router: 60 minutes when trend_eff_15 >= previous-126 same-checkpoint median, otherwise 30 minutes

candidate_resolution.per_specialist_first_event: scan checkpoints chronologically and retain first qualifying event per specialist per date
candidate_resolution.same_timestamp_conflict: if CONT and REJECT somehow qualify at the same timestamp, reject both and WAIT
candidate_resolution.portfolio_execution: merge the two specialist streams chronologically and permit only one open trade at a time
candidate_resolution.entry: next genuine same-session minute open after signal checkpoint

qualification.if_2023_passes: freeze R3L configuration and then and only then open 2024 audit
qualification.if_2023_fails: retire R3L without opening 2024; preregister distinct R3M before any R3M output

option_gate.data: genuine 2024 full-chain NIFTY option candles from authorized Sep-Oct expiry weeks
